notes: Tuition: DAAD page states 1,500 EUR for non-EU applicants but DAAD labels it 'per semester'; the university page confirms 1,500 EUR tuition fee per semester for non-EU degree-seeking students. An EEB-specific cost page is linked but not supplied. Application deadline: programme page gives 31 July generally and says 'For international students this should not be later than 15 May' (soft recommendation, no year), consistent with DAAD 'non-EU countries: 15 April - 15 May' for the winter semester, so the date is left out of intakes. No uni-assist mention on any supplied page: the pages say apply via the university's own Campusportal (de-university-direct).
